title: Merchandise Purchases Customer Terms — Gift Card or Bonus Card Value Redeemed but Left Undeducted
content:
**Rule.** When the gift card ledger shows any Marlowe & Finch gift card, Bonus Card included, redeemed on a Merchandise Purchases purchase record but the unit's payment was captured as if the card had not been used, the customer was charged for the part the card had already paid.

**How the claim is made.** The claim is the customer's own act: the customer files it in person through the gift card claim on the order, with the amount this rule gives, as a register-error adjustment refunded to the unit's original tender; the gift card value is not put back on the gift card, and the correction records no new unit price.

**Scope.** For gift card or Bonus Card value recorded as redeemed on a unit but left undeducted that this policy handles, and only for such value, the register-error adjustment is still made at any time while the unit is not returned and still counts toward no limit, and it refunds the card money captured for the part the gift card had paid together with the incident escalation credit, the gift card service credit and the goodwill amounts; every other register error, including a unit rung above its shelf ticket; registry credit recorded as spent but left undeducted; the card money taken for a Finch Note recorded as redeemed but left undeducted; sales tax charged on the part a Finch Note paid; and a second capture of the same tender, stays under the base rule or the rule written for it.

**When the refund is fixed.**
- The gift card shortfall refund is fixed only after the unit's records carry a register-error correction for every Finch Note recorded as redeemed on the unit but left undeducted.
- The gift card shortfall refund is not settled until the sales tax charged on the part paid by every Finch Note recorded as redeemed on the unit but left undeducted carries its register-error correction on the unit's records.
- Before the gift card shortfall refund is fixed, every second capture of the unit's payment must carry its register-error correction on the unit's records.

## Basis Q&A

- *Is the gift card balance restored?* No; the value is not put back on the gift card.
- *Does a Bonus Card count?* Yes; any Marlowe & Finch gift card, Bonus Card included.
- *Where is the refund paid?* To the unit's original tender.
- *Who files the claim?* The customer, in person, through the gift card claim on the order.

## Handing the claim to the customer — `claim_gift_card_shortfall_5b13f7c5`

**Capability.** Files a gift card shortfall claim on one of the customer's own purchases: the customer claims back the card money charged for the part of the purchase a Marlowe & Finch gift card or Bonus Card had already paid, with the amount the representative gave. On success one price adjustment entry with the current date and the reason register price error is added to the purchase, with no new unit price; the amount is refunded to the tender the customer paid with, and the purchase's amount paid and not refunded goes down by the same amount. The card balances are not changed. The customer sees the refund on the original tender.

**How it is invoked.** `claim_gift_card_shortfall_5b13f7c5` is the customer's own tool: the agent unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

**Parameters.**
- `purchase_id` — the reference number of the customer's purchase record (one unit of one item) the claim is for, as read to the customer by the representative from the purchase lookup; identifier text.
- `amount` — the claim amount refunded, as the representative gave it; USD, 2 decimal places, positive, rounded half up to the cent before it is passed; never empty.

Neither parameter takes an enumerated value.

**Return.** A confirmation sentence naming the new price adjustment reference number (an opaque text reference), the purchase record reference number, the amount refunded (USD, 2 decimal places), the tender refunded, and the unit's remaining amount paid and not refunded (USD, 2 decimal places). A sentence starting with "Gift card shortfall claim filed" means the entry was recorded.
